description: `<program trusted-proxies=1>` — a bare integer in 0..=32. Isolates the value form from the attribute itself.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6
rationale: §40.2: `trusted-proxies=N` with a bare integer from 0 to 32 declares N reverse proxies in front of the server; it is legal and raises no E-MW-009.
